fields.checked: number of reachable chained rows inspected from the stored tip
fields.hash_mismatches: inspected rows whose canonical content no longer hashes to row_hash
fields.link_breaks: inspected rows whose predecessor hash is missing or cyclic
fields.bad_ids: up to ten IDs of inspected damaged rows; never invent deleted IDs
fields.unchained_total: legacy rows written before the hash chain
fields.tail_state_mismatch: state row is absent, tip is missing/detached, or nonempty rows contradict an empty tip
